title: Publication preparation, pilot protocol, and data-capture controls

non_blocking_for: T1 and baseline pipeline pilot runs

purpose: Prepare and pilot a reproducible synthetic experiment pipeline without converting provisional mappings, parameters, outputs, or analysis-plan candidates into publication evidence.

research_questions.text: Within the declared abstract model, how do B0, B1, B2, and provisional T1 classify recovery outcomes under matched fault scenarios?
research_questions.publication_prerequisite: Equivalent scenario execution and metric capture must exist for every treatment.

research_questions.text: Within discrete contact windows, how do recovery duration, retry overhead, security state, and availability state vary across matched fault schedules?
research_questions.publication_prerequisite: Metric definitions, denominators, exclusions, and treatment parity must be frozen before the publication-candidate run.

research_questions.text: Where do bounded formal witnesses and Python execution traces agree or differ under the declared projection?
research_questions.publication_prerequisite: Any external statement must retain bounded-execution and projection qualifiers.

limits: Each baseline catalog case is represented as one adapter contact.
Transmission counts are declared scenario-level adapter values.
Null seed values indicate deterministic catalog execution.
The adapter does not create matched seeded fault populations.
Metric-field parity does not establish semantic, timing, or treatment comparability.

matched_family_population.policy_variant_rule: The two CF-02 B1 variants remain separate member rows but share one B1 analysis unit.

pilot_scope.label: PILOT_INTERNAL_VALIDATION_ONLY
pilot_scope.primary_goal: Validate T1 schedule generation, B0/B1/B2 catalog adaptation, treatment comparability, the executable qualified-family population, immutable D2/D3 capture, and an outcome-blind candidate registry for observation cutoffs and denominators without producing comparative results.
pilot_scope.baseline_activity: Execute all 21 deterministic baseline catalog scenarios through the metric adapter and verify their existing design oracles; do not treat adapter rows as matched seeded treatment evidence.
pilot_scope.comparability_activity: Validate scenario classification, execute member-level rows for the four qualified families, enforce family-specific metric authorization, and generate outcome-blind observation and denominator candidates; do not display member values, calculate pooled rates, or perform inferential comparison.

inclusion_rules: Include every successfully parsed run produced from the exact recorded configuration and serialized schedule.
Include every baseline catalog scenario in its declared order.
Include every qualified-family matrix member in the executable D3 population.
Include every declared D4 member and analysis-unit identity without reading projected values.
Include adverse, indeterminate, degraded, expired, locked, unsafe, divergent, and success outcomes without outcome-based filtering.
Retain zero-fault schedules generated by the declared seed process.
Retain low-count groups and label them descriptive-only.
exclusion_rules: Exclude only runs with documented technical execution failure, corrupted output, schema failure, checksum failure, configuration mismatch, or catalog-oracle mismatch.
Do not exclude a run because its outcome is unexpected, unfavorable, or inconvenient.
Do not shrink or expand a family denominator after any member value is observed.
Record every exclusion with run ID, reason, evidence path, and disposition before aggregate interpretation.

rerun_policy.prohibited_reason: Rerunning solely to obtain a preferred outcome or aggregate result.
rerun_policy.preservation_rule: Preserve the original failed or superseded attempt and link it to the rerun record.
rerun_policy.comparison_rule: Do not combine pre-correction and post-correction runs in one aggregate unless the protocol explicitly defines a stratified analysis.

required_provenance: serialized schedules and schedule SHA-256 values
T1 and baseline raw result JSON
baseline and T1 catalogs and SHA-256 values
derived matched-family JSON and CSV files
run-level raw, derived, analysis, and bundle manifests
capture_requirements.raw_data_rule: Raw generated outputs are immutable after capture; corrections produce a new run directory.
capture_requirements.processed_data_rule: Every processed artifact must identify its source files, script, commit, and checksum.

pilot_entry_gate: Unit tests and the Phase 15 validators pass.
The baseline adapter executes all 21 catalog scenarios and matches every existing design oracle.
The treatment-comparability validator accounts for all 21 baseline and 15 T1 catalog scenarios exactly once.
The matched-family population runner executes 13 qualified-family member rows and 12 analysis units with no aggregate authorization.
The integrated disposable capture retains exact D2 and D3 inputs, executes D3 only after T1 and baseline success, and records completed-and-verified D3 metadata.
The D3 internal manifest and run-level raw, derived, analysis, and complete-bundle manifests verify.
The capture wrapper completes a disposable smoke run and rejects missing, tampered, or semantically relaxed D3 output.
The D4 generator reproduces 4 family cutoffs, 13 member identities, 12 analysis-unit identities, and 4 candidate denominators without reading projected or raw values.
The D4 member registry contains no outcome or projected-metric value column and its manifest verifies.
No unresolved critical internal defect affects capture or plan generation.
publication_candidate_entry_gate: Pilot run and analysis pipeline reproduce from retained configuration and checksums.
Baseline B0, B1, and B2 runners provide validated metric-field and capture parity with T1.
The matched treatment-scenario matrix is validated and every treatment-specific exception remains explicit.
The executable qualified-family population is validated and retained in the immutable capture bundle.
The D4 observation cutoffs, analysis-unit denominators, member registry, and allowed-display plan are separately reviewed and frozen before any comparative display is viewed.
Adapter contact and transmission semantics are accepted, replaced, or explicitly excluded before comparative analysis.
Family-specific denominators and observation cutoffs are versioned before viewing comparative aggregates.
Final seed, parameter, exclusion, threshold, and statistical-analysis decisions are versioned before viewing publication aggregates.
All open defects affecting scientific validity are closed or explicitly accepted as limitations.
The external-review status and unresolved claim boundaries are stated accurately.
